operation.summary: Export all accessible saved rows, schemas, status and photo references as JSON, or ZIP with manifest.json and original JPEGs. Read-only; no model calls, captures or Android share sheet. Same control-key authorization as data

query.name: format
query.description: json (default) or zip; at most 20 MB; larger datasets use paginated rows and individual photos

operation.returns: JSON bridgit-applet-data/2 with tables[].rows, or application/zip containing manifest.json and photos/*.jpg; missing photos are explicitly marked, not recaptured; live read, not an atomic snapshot
